info.title: Golf Genius API v2
info.description:
Golf Genius API documentation providing programmatic access to Golf Genius data.

## General Considerations
- IDs returned by the Golf Genius API need to be treated as Numeric 22 or String
- An API Key is required to access the API

## Getting Started
Contact Golf Genius Support if you are a Golf Genius user or a third-party provider to users of Golf Genius

## Authentication
The API supports two authentication methods:
1. **URL Path Parameter**: `{api_key}` embedded in the URL path for read operations
2. **Bearer Token**: `Authorization: Bearer {api_key}` header for write operations
